+# Complete native protocols and arbitrary position cuts
+
+## Abstract
+
+Physical Born normalization for the complete original sixteen-bit protocol tree.
+
+**Theorem 1.1 (The complete original tree has unit total mass and every acquired event has its actual cut trace).**
+
+$$(\forall L: \operatorname{Type}\left(\right), (\forall T: \operatorname{Tree}\left(L\right), (\forall e: \operatorname{Function}\left(\operatorname{Path}\left(T\right), \operatorname{Bool}\left(\right)\right), (\forall I: \operatorname{Finset}\left(\operatorname{Fin}\left(16\right)\right), ((((\sum_{p \in \operatorname{Path}\left(T\right)} \sum_{z \in \operatorname{Basis}\left(\right)} \operatorname{mass}\left(T, p, z\right) = 1) \land ((0 \leq \operatorname{eventMass}\left(T, \operatorname{historyEvent}\left(e\right)\right)) \land (\operatorname{eventMass}\left(T, \operatorname{historyEvent}\left(e\right)\right) \leq 1))) \land \operatorname{PosSemidef}\left(\operatorname{eventCut}\left(T, I, e\right)\right)) \land (\operatorname{trace}\left(\operatorname{eventCut}\left(T, I, e\right)\right) = \operatorname{complex}\left(\operatorname{eventMass}\left(T, \operatorname{historyEvent}\left(e\right)\right)\right)))))))$$
+
+*Proof.* Machine-checked in Lean as `D5/S3/Quantum/Dynamics/NativeProtocolBornNormalization.original_complete_born_law` (`✓ std3`). ∎
+
+*Source.* Repository-derived.
+
+*Acknowledgement.* Giulio Chiribella; Giacomo M. D'Ariano; Paolo Perinotti (2009). *Theoretical framework for quantum networks*. DOI: [10.1103/PhysRevA.80.022339](https://doi.org/10.1103/PhysRevA.80.022339). URL: <https://arxiv.org/abs/0904.4483v2>.
+
+*Commentary.*
+
+Generality I: normalization and the same-cut resource bounds concern the fixed original sixteen-bit golden protocol and its instance-specific arithmetic dependency closure. Quantification over all native trees, events and position cuts does not extend these statements to arbitrary carriers or quadratic fields.
+
+The objects are the original NativeProtocolGraft.Tree, Basis, omega0, gate, callMatrix, projector, Path and mass. Basis consists of all sixteen-bit words at the shifted original positions. The unique fixed root has ones at positions 0, 4 and 8. The proof uses the full matrices at every address in Fin 14, rather than a two-dimensional model supplied as an additional premise.
+
+On each active center-bit pair the actual gate coefficients are a,b,c from the existing calibration calculation. Their existing squared norms, the golden quadratic identity and the actual phase norm give orthogonal unit rows. The remaining control blocks are zero or identity before the phase gate. Reindexing the full carrier by the center-bit involution proves exact energy conservation. Forward calls use this identity and inverse syntax uses nine iterations of the same actual matrix. The original resource counter still charges nine calls; no semantic equality with a separately defined matrix inverse is asserted.
+
+The sum of all terminal squared amplitudes is conserved for every incoming full-carrier vector. Its proof recurses over the original finite tree. Each gate preserves energy, and each selector projector keeps precisely one outcome for every basis word, so the complete outcome sum preserves energy exactly. Each child can have its own feedback addresses, depth and stopping label. Unused outcomes, zero vectors, refusals, failures and early stops remain in the original Path type and its sum. No total-probability, gate-unitarity or projector-completeness certificate is an input.
+
+Applying that conservation to the original normalized computational root gives unit total Born mass, including every final computational result. An acquired event is a Boolean function of the original prefix path, independent of any future report. The existing original_event_cut_mass_and_psd theorem supplies the same acquired event's b1 marginal and exact real trace. Its positive semidefinite matrix has nonnegative trace, giving the zero lower bound; domination by the complete Born sum gives the upper bound one. Any declared complete prefix is itself such a Tree; the theorem therefore applies at that same common cut.
+
+For any subset I of the sixteen positions, including the empty and full subsets, splitAt is the pinned equivalence restricting a word to I and its complement. The row and complement bases are Boolean functions on those two actual position subtypes. Their dimensions are two to the cardinality of I and two to the cardinality of its complement. cutReduced is the existing right partial trace of the outer product of the same actual branch vector after this coordinate equivalence. eventCut sums those matrices over exactly the acquired histories. The existing partial-trace positivity and trace theorems supply positive semidefiniteness and equality of its complex trace with the real event mass. This reduction is a mathematical marginal and adds no physical record deletion, new register or coherent sum of distinct histories.
+
+This is a partial consequence of V88 definitions 23.1 and 23.2 and the physical trace premise used in theorem 24.1. The same-cut integer-coordinate and signed-embedding theorem below supplies the determinant descent. The resource theorem then proves the determinant and both minimum-eigenvalue lower bounds, conditional on positive event mass and full rank of that same cut. The positive-event scalar bound reuses original_event_resource_bounds. Faithful-cut existence, the five-call reference history and the full-record Petz compiler remain separate mathematical obligations.
+
+**Theorem 1.2 (Quadratic integer coordinates and the exact signed embedding of the same cut).**
+
+$$(\forall L: \operatorname{Type}\left(\right), (\forall T: \operatorname{Tree}\left(L\right), (\forall e: \operatorname{Function}\left(\operatorname{Path}\left(T\right), \operatorname{Bool}\left(\right)\right), (\forall I: \operatorname{Finset}\left(\operatorname{Fin}\left(16\right)\right), ((((\operatorname{trace}\left(\operatorname{eventCut}\left(T, I, e\right)\right) = \operatorname{complex}\left(\operatorname{eventMass}\left(T, \operatorname{historyEvent}\left(e\right)\right)\right)) \land (\operatorname{det}\left(\operatorname{eventCut}\left(T, I, e\right)\right) = \operatorname{complex}\left(\operatorname{realPhysical}\left(\operatorname{cutDetCoordinates}\left(T, I, e\right)\right)\right))) \land (\operatorname{det}\left(\operatorname{conjugateEventCut}\left(T, I, e\right)\right) = \operatorname{complex}\left(\operatorname{realConjugate}\left(\operatorname{cutDetCoordinates}\left(T, I, e\right)\right)\right))) \land (\forall i: \operatorname{CutBasis}\left(I\right), (\forall j: \operatorname{CutBasis}\left(I\right), (\operatorname{Apply}\left(\operatorname{conjugateEventCut}\left(T, I, e\right), i, j\right) = \sum_{p \in \operatorname{Path}\left(T\right)} \sum_{z \in \operatorname{CutRest}\left(I\right)} \operatorname{if}\left(\operatorname{Apply}\left(e, p\right), {{-1}}^{\operatorname{restExponent}\left(I, z\right)+\operatorname{rowExponent}\left(I, j\right)}*\operatorname{conjugateAmplitude}\left(\operatorname{branch}\left(T, p, \operatorname{initial}\left(\right)\right), \operatorname{splitAtInverse}\left(I, i, z\right)\right)*\operatorname{star}\left(\operatorname{conjugateAmplitude}\left(\operatorname{branch}\left(T, p, \operatorname{initial}\left(\right)\right), \operatorname{splitAtInverse}\left(I, j, z\right)\right)\right), 0\right)))))))))$$
+
+*Proof.* Machine-checked in Lean as `D5/S3/Quantum/Dynamics/NativeProtocolBornNormalization.original_event_cut_integer_coordinates` (`✓ std3`). ∎
+
+*Source.* Repository-derived.

+*Acknowledgement.* Ian Stewart and David Tall (2025). *Algebraic Number Theory and Fermat's Last Theorem*. DOI: [10.1201/9781003462002](https://doi.org/10.1201/9781003462002).
+
+*Commentary.*
+
+The theorem quantifies over the unchanged original tree, its acquired-path event and any subset I of the sixteen positions. The same eventCut supplies both the complex trace and the determinant. No positivity, covariance, gate-unitarity or normalization certificate is assumed. The statement includes zero events, singular cuts, and empty and full subsets; it makes no full-rank inference.
+
+Let r(i) be the retained word's Hamming parity as zero or one. Let s(z) be the complementary word's parity relative to the fixed original root. Restriction along splitAt proves that the original relative exponent is r(i) plus s(z), modulo two. In the inverse-golden integer ring tau times (tau plus one) equals one. Multiplying the computed coefficient by tau plus one to the power r(i)s(z) therefore extracts the physical factors beta to r(i) and beta to s(z) without leaving the four-integer coefficient ring. The histories and the complementary word are unchanged.
+
+cutKernel is the sum over exactly the selected original histories and complementary words of tau to s(z) times the extracted coefficient at i times the coefficient conjugate at j. This conjugation fixes the inverse-golden base ring and sends eta to minus tau minus eta. The original eventCut is the physical evaluation of this kernel multiplied on both sides by the diagonal beta to r(i). The kernel equals its coefficient conjugate transpose, so its determinant is fixed by that conjugation. In the two explicit integer coordinates this forces its eta coefficient to vanish. Multiplying its surviving inverse-golden pair by the product of tau to r(i) gives cutDetCoordinates, an actually computed element of O, with the physical determinant as its realPhysical evaluation.
+
+conjugateEventCut applies the nonphysical homomorphism to this exact same kernel and uses the nonphysical beta on both sides. Its determinant is realConjugate of the same cutDetCoordinates. Since the nonphysical beta is imaginary, this embedded matrix equals the sum of embedded branch outer products with sign minus one to s(z) plus r(j). Equivalently it is A C A adjoint J, with complement sign C and row-parity sign J. Replacing this expression by an unsigned positive Gram matrix would change the nonphysical determinant. Coefficient conjugation is proved compatible with both S evaluations; conjugation of the square-root factor supplies the displayed sign.
+
+These are the same-cut arithmetic descent and embedding identities used in V88 theorem 24.1, equations 24.7, 24.9 and 24.10. The resource theorem consumes them to bound the determinant and the two spectra. Positive event mass keeps its existing original_event_resource_bounds lower bound. Faithfulness means full rank of this same eventCut; positive mass alone does not imply it.
+
+**Theorem 1.3 (Sharp determinant and minimum-eigenvalue bounds at the original cut).**
+
+$$(\forall L: \operatorname{Type}\left(\right), (\forall T: \operatorname{Tree}\left(L\right), (\forall e: \operatorname{Function}\left(\operatorname{Path}\left(T\right), \operatorname{Bool}\left(\right)\right), (\forall I: \operatorname{Finset}\left(\operatorname{Fin}\left(16\right)\right), (((\operatorname{trace}\left(\operatorname{eventCut}\left(T, I, e\right)\right) = \operatorname{complex}\left(\operatorname{eventMass}\left(T, \operatorname{historyEvent}\left(e\right)\right)\right)) \land \operatorname{abs}\left(\operatorname{realConjugate}\left(\operatorname{cutDetCoordinates}\left(T, I, e\right)\right)\right) \le {\operatorname{kappa}\left(\right)}^{2*\operatorname{maxCalls}\left(T\right)*\operatorname{card}\left(\operatorname{CutBasis}\left(I\right)\right)}) \land (0 < \operatorname{eventMass}\left(T, \operatorname{historyEvent}\left(e\right)\right) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{inv}\left({\operatorname{kappa}\left(\right)}^{2*\operatorname{maxCalls}\left(T\right)}\right) \le \operatorname{eventMass}\left(T, \operatorname{historyEvent}\left(e\right)\right) \land ((\operatorname{rank}\left(\operatorname{eventCut}\left(T, I, e\right)\right) = \operatorname{card}\left(\operatorname{CutBasis}\left(I\right)\right)) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{inv}\left({\operatorname{kappa}\left(\right)}^{2*\operatorname{maxCalls}\left(T\right)*\operatorname{card}\left(\operatorname{CutBasis}\left(I\right)\right)}\right) \le \operatorname{re}\left(\operatorname{det}\left(\operatorname{eventCut}\left(T, I, e\right)\right)\right) \land (\exists h: \operatorname{IsHermitian}\left(\operatorname{eventCut}\left(T, I, e\right)\right), (\exists q: \operatorname{IsHermitian}\left(\operatorname{smul}\left(\operatorname{complex}\left(\operatorname{inv}\left(\operatorname{eventMass}\left(T, \operatorname{historyEvent}\left(e\right)\right)\right)\right), \operatorname{eventCut}\left(T, I, e\right)\right)\right), (\operatorname{inv}\left({\operatorname{kappa}\left(\right)}^{2*\operatorname{maxCalls}\left(T\right)*\operatorname{card}\left(\operatorname{CutBasis}\left(I\right)\right)}\right) \le \operatorname{iInf}\left(\operatorname{eigenvalues}\left(h\right)\right) \land \frac{\operatorname{inv}\left({\operatorname{kappa}\left(\right)}^{2*\operatorname{maxCalls}\left(T\right)*\operatorname{card}\left(\operatorname{CutBasis}\left(I\right)\right)}\right)}{\operatorname{eventMass}\left(T, \operatorname{historyEvent}\left(e\right)\right)} \le \operatorname{iInf}\left(\operatorname{eigenvalues}\left(q\right)\right)))))))))))))$$

+*Commentary.*
+
+The objects are the same actual finite adaptive tree T, Boolean acquired-path event e and position subset I used by the preceding two theorems. Write Xi=eventCut(T,I,e), p=eventMass(T,historyEvent(e)), d=card(CutBasis(I)), L=maxCalls(T), K=kappa to the power 2Ld, and rho=Xi/p. Each inverse letter still costs nine forward calls. The trace and nonphysical bound are unconditional, including zero events and singular cuts. The scalar lower bound requires positive p, and the determinant and spectral bounds additionally require rank(Xi)=d. The two existential witnesses certify Hermiticity of Xi and of the actual normalized matrix rho; they are conclusions, not supplied certificates.
+
+For each retained pair i,j, the exact signed embedding is summed over the unchanged original history and complementary-word pairs. Its signs have norm one. The triangle inequality and the finite Cauchy-Schwarz inequality bound the squared entry norm by the product of the two row energies. Summing over i,j gives the square of the complete original tree energy: splitAt merely reindexes every original word, and discarding the event restriction only increases that energy. Thus the embedded matrix's Frobenius norm is at most the complete tree energy, already bounded by kappa to the power 2L. No leaf count, record count or dimension multiplier enters.
+
+For the Gram matrix M adjoint times M, all eigenvalues are nonnegative and each is at most its trace, the squared Frobenius norm of M. The product of these eigenvalues is the squared norm of det(M). This gives the determinant bound energy to the power d, hence absolute realConjugate(cutDetCoordinates) at most K for the exact embedded cut. The estimate never treats that signed matrix as positive or Hermitian.
+
+Full rank of the physical Xi implies its matrix is a unit, so the already proved physical positive semidefiniteness gives positive definiteness and a strictly positive determinant. The existing inverse-golden integer norm lemma positive_lower applies directly to cutDetCoordinates and the proved conjugate bound. Its physical evaluation is det(Xi), so det(Xi) is at least one divided by K. This reuses the same quadratic integer coordinates and does not introduce a second norm estimate for a denominator.
+
+The physical trace is the same raw p and is at most one. Every nonnegative eigenvalue is therefore at most one; their product, det(Xi), is at most each eigenvalue. The infimum of this finite nonempty spectrum is at least one divided by K. The existing eigenvalues_zero_smul_finite theorem identifies the actual spectrum of rho with the spectrum of Xi multiplied by one divided by that same positive p, giving the normalized lower bound one divided by Kp. Existence of a faithful original cut, the full five-call reference history, the Petz mass and full-identity complement, record extension, failure zeros and total-variation comparison, and semantic equality of the ninth power with the inverse remain separate results.

+  have hg := Coeff.flip_sum (center j) (fun z => Complex.normSq ((gate j).mulVec w z))
+  have hw := Coeff.flip_sum (center j) (fun z => Complex.normSq (w z))
+  rw [hg, hw] at h
+  dsimp [Coeff.energy]
+  linarith
+
+private theorem power_energy (j : Address) (n : ℕ) (w : Basis → ℂ) :
+    Coeff.energy ((gate j ^ n).mulVec w) = Coeff.energy w := by
+  induction n generalizing w with
+  | zero => simp
+  | succ n ih =>
+    rw [pow_succ, ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, ih, gate_energy]
+
+private theorem call_energy (j : Address) (d : Direction) (w : Basis → ℂ) :
+    Coeff.energy ((callMatrix j d).mulVec w) = Coeff.energy w := by
+  cases d
+  · exact gate_energy j w
+  · exact power_energy j 9 w
+
+private theorem measurement_energy {n : ℕ} (select : Basis → Fin n)
+    (w : Basis → ℂ) :
+    (∑ o, Coeff.energy ((projector select o).mulVec w)) = Coeff.energy w := by
+  classical
+  unfold Coeff.energy
+  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
+  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
+  intro z _
+  simp [projector, Matrix.mulVec_diagonal, apply_ite]
+
+/-- Conservation for arbitrary incoming vectors, proved on the original
+finite tree with every outcome and its own continuation retained. -/
+private theorem whole_tree_energy {L : Type} (T : NativeProtocolGraft.Tree L) (w : Basis → ℂ) :
+    (∑ p : Path T, Coeff.energy ((operator T p).mulVec w)) = Coeff.energy w := by
+  classical
+  induction T generalizing w with
+  | leaf l =>
+    change (∑ _p : Unit, Coeff.energy ((1 : Mat).mulVec w)) = Coeff.energy w
+    simp
+  | call j d U ih =>
+    change (∑ p : Path U, Coeff.energy
+      ((operator U p * callMatrix j d).mulVec w)) = _
+    simp only [← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec]
+    rw [ih, call_energy]
+  | measure n select U ih =>
+    change (∑ p : (o : Fin n) × Path (U o), Coeff.energy
+      ((operator (U p.1) p.2 * projector select p.1).mulVec w)) = _
+    simp only [← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec]
+    rw [Fintype.sum_sigma]
+    simp_rw [ih]
+    exact measurement_energy select w
+
+/-- Computational coordinates on precisely the selected original positions. -/
+abbrev CutBasis (I : Finset (Fin 16)) := {i : Fin 16 // i ∈ I} → Bool
+abbrev CutRest (I : Finset (Fin 16)) := {i : Fin 16 // i ∉ I} → Bool
+
+def splitAt (I : Finset (Fin 16)) : Basis ≃ CutBasis I × CutRest I :=
+  Equiv.piEquivPiSubtypeProd (fun i => i ∈ I) (fun _ => Bool)
+
+/-- The original branch vector reduced at the actual position subset. -/
+def cutReduced (I : Finset (Fin 16)) (v : Basis → ℂ) :
+    Matrix (CutBasis I) (CutBasis I) ℂ :=
+  D5.S3.Quantum.Information.PartialTraceMutualInformation.partialTraceRight
+    (Matrix.vecMulVec (v ∘ (splitAt I).symm) (star (v ∘ (splitAt I).symm)))
+
+/-- Sum of original unnormalized branch reductions over the acquired paths. -/
+def eventCut {L : Type} (T : NativeProtocolGraft.Tree L) (I : Finset (Fin 16))
+    (event : Path T → Bool) : Matrix (CutBasis I) (CutBasis I) ℂ :=
+  ∑ p, if event p then cutReduced I ((operator T p).mulVec omega0) else 0
+
+private theorem cutReduced_trace (I : Finset (Fin 16)) (v : Basis → ℂ) :
+    (cutReduced I v).trace = (Coeff.energy v : ℂ) := by
+  rw [cutReduced,
+    D5.S3.Quantum.Information.PartialTraceMutualInformation.trace_partialTraceRight]
+  simp only [Matrix.trace, Matrix.diag_apply, Matrix.vecMulVec_apply,
+    Function.comp_apply, Pi.star_apply, Coeff.energy]
+  rw [← (splitAt I).sum_comp]
+  simp only [Equiv.symm_apply_apply, Complex.ofReal_sum,
+    Complex.normSq_eq_conj_mul_self, ← Complex.star_def]
+  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
+  intro z _
+  ring
+
+private theorem event_mass_energy {L : Type} (T : NativeProtocolGraft.Tree L)
+    (event : Path T → Bool) :
+    eventMass T (historyEvent event) =
+      ∑ p, if event p then Coeff.energy ((operator T p).mulVec omega0) else 0 := by
+  unfold eventMass historyEvent mass
+  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
+  intro p _
+  by_cases he : event p
+  · simp [he, Coeff.energy]
+  · simp [he]
+
+private theorem eventCut_trace {L : Type} (T : NativeProtocolGraft.Tree L)
+    (I : Finset (Fin 16)) (event : Path T → Bool) :
+    (eventCut T I event).trace = (eventMass T (historyEvent event) : ℂ) := by
+  rw [event_mass_energy, eventCut, Matrix.trace_sum, Complex.ofReal_sum]
+  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
+  intro p _
+  by_cases he : event p <;> simp [he, cutReduced_trace]
+
+private theorem eventCut_positive {L : Type} (T : NativeProtocolGraft.Tree L)
+    (I : Finset (Fin 16)) (event : Path T → Bool) :
+    (eventCut T I event).PosSemidef := by
+  classical
+  unfold eventCut
+  apply Matrix.posSemidef_sum
+  intro p _
+  split_ifs
+  · exact D5.S3.Quantum.Information.PartialTraceMutualInformation.partialTraceRight_posSemidef
+      (Matrix.posSemidef_vecMulVec_self_star _)
+  · exact Matrix.PosSemidef.zero
+
+/-- The original complete Born law and the raw trace of the same acquired
+history event at every original position cut, without normalization premises. -/
+theorem original_complete_born_law {L : Type} (T : NativeProtocolGraft.Tree L)
+    (event : Path T → Bool) (I : Finset (Fin 16)) :
+    (∑ p, ∑ z, mass T p z) = 1 ∧
+    (0 ≤ eventMass T (historyEvent event) ∧ eventMass T (historyEvent event) ≤ 1) ∧
+    (eventCut T I event).PosSemidef ∧
+    (eventCut T I event).trace = (eventMass T (historyEvent event) : ℂ) := by
+  classical
+  have ht : (∑ p, ∑ z, mass T p z) = 1 := by
+    change (∑ p, Coeff.energy ((operator T p).mulVec omega0)) = 1
+    rw [whole_tree_energy]
+    simp [Coeff.energy, omega0]
+  have hn : 0 ≤ eventMass T (historyEvent event) := by
+    have hc := original_event_cut_mass_and_psd T event
+    rw [← hc.1]
+    exact (RCLike.nonneg_iff.mp hc.2.1.trace_nonneg).1
+  have hb : eventMass T (historyEvent event) ≤ ∑ p, ∑ z, mass T p z := by
+    unfold eventMass
+    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
+    intro p _
+    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
+    intro z _
+    split_ifs
+    · exact le_rfl
+    · exact Complex.normSq_nonneg _
+  exact ⟨ht, ⟨hn, hb.trans_eq ht⟩, eventCut_positive T I event, eventCut_trace T I event⟩
+
+
+/-- Hamming parity on the retained and complementary original positions. -/
+def rowParity (I : Finset (Fin 16)) (i : CutBasis I) : ZMod 2 :=
+  ∑ k, if i k then 1 else 0
+
+def restParity (I : Finset (Fin 16)) (z : CutRest I) : ZMod 2 :=
+  (∑ k, if z k then 1 else 0) -
+    ∑ k : Fin 16, if rootWord k then 1 else 0
+
+def rowExponent (I : Finset (Fin 16)) (i : CutBasis I) : ℕ :=
+  if rowParity I i = 0 then 0 else 1
+
+def restExponent (I : Finset (Fin 16)) (z : CutRest I) : ℕ :=
+  if restParity I z = 0 then 0 else 1
+
+private theorem zmod_cases (x : ZMod 2) : x = 0 ∨ x = 1 := by
+  have hv := x.val_lt
+  have hr := ZMod.natCast_zmod_val x
+  interval_cases x.val <;> simp_all
+
+private theorem split_parity (I : Finset (Fin 16)) (i : CutBasis I) (z : CutRest I) :
+    Coeff.parity ((splitAt I).symm (i,z)) = rowParity I i + restParity I z := by
+  classical
+  have hl (k : {k : Fin 16 // k ∈ I}) :
+      ((splitAt I).symm (i,z)) k = i k := by
+    change (if h : k.val ∈ I then i ⟨k.val,h⟩ else z ⟨k.val,h⟩) = i k
+    simp only [dite_eq_left k.property]
+  have hr (k : {k : Fin 16 // k ∉ I}) :
+      ((splitAt I).symm (i,z)) k = z k := by
+    change (if h : k.val ∈ I then i ⟨k.val,h⟩ else z ⟨k.val,h⟩) = z k
+    simp only [dite_eq_right k.property]
+  have hs := Fintype.sum_subtype_add_sum_subtype (fun k : Fin 16 => k ∈ I)
+    (fun k => if ((splitAt I).symm (i,z)) k then (1 : ZMod 2) else 0)
+  simp only [hl,hr] at hs
+  unfold Coeff.parity rowParity restParity
+  rw [← hs, add_sub_assoc]
+  congr 1
+  apply Finset.sum_congr
+  · ext k; simp
+  · intro k _; rfl
+
+private theorem split_exponent (I : Finset (Fin 16)) (i : CutBasis I) (z : CutRest I) :
+    Coeff.exponent ((splitAt I).symm (i,z)) =
+      (rowExponent I i + restExponent I z) % 2 := by
+  rcases zmod_cases (rowParity I i) with hi | hi <;>
+    rcases zmod_cases (restParity I z) with hz | hz <;>
+    norm_num [Coeff.exponent, split_parity, rowExponent, restExponent, hi, hz] <;> decide
+
+/-- Removing the row and column square-root factors stays in the original
+four-integer coefficient ring, since tau inverse is tau plus one. -/
+def cutCoefficient (I : Finset (Fin 16)) (h : Basis → Coeff.S)
+    (i : CutBasis I) (z : CutRest I) : Coeff.S :=
+  Coeff.inc ((Coeff.tau+1)^(rowExponent I i * restExponent I z)) *
+    h ((splitAt I).symm (i,z))
+
+private theorem cut_amplitude (I : Finset (Fin 16)) (h : Basis → Coeff.S)
+    (i : CutBasis I) (z : CutRest I) :
+    Coeff.amplitude h ((splitAt I).symm (i,z)) =
+      beta^rowExponent I i * beta^restExponent I z *
+        Coeff.physical (cutCoefficient I h i z) := by
+  have hi : rowExponent I i = 0 ∨ rowExponent I i = 1 := by
+    unfold rowExponent; split_ifs <;> simp
+  have hz : restExponent I z = 0 ∨ restExponent I z = 1 := by
+    unfold restExponent; split_ifs <;> simp
+  have ht : Coeff.physical (Coeff.inc Coeff.tau) = t := by
+    simp [Coeff.physical, Coeff.evalS, Coeff.inc]
+  have he := split_exponent I i z
+  unfold Coeff.amplitude cutCoefficient
+  simp only [map_mul, map_pow, map_add, map_one, ht]
+  rw [he]
+  rcases hi with hi | hi <;> rcases hz with hz | hz <;>
+    simp only [hi,hz,Nat.zero_mul,Nat.mul_zero,Nat.one_mul,Nat.mul_one,
+      Nat.zero_add,Nat.add_zero,pow_zero,pow_one,one_mul] <;> norm_num
+  rw [← mul_assoc, ← pow_two, Coeff.beta_sq]
+  have htq := Coeff.t_sq
+  linear_combination -(Coeff.physical (h ((splitAt I).symm (i,z)))) * htq
+
+
+private theorem evalS_star (u v : ℂ) (hu hv) (huStar : star u = u)
+    (hvStar : v + star v = -u) (x : Coeff.S) :
+    Coeff.evalS u v hu hv (star x) = star (Coeff.evalS u v hu hv x) := by
+  have hr (a : Coeff.O) : star (Coeff.evalO u hu a) = Coeff.evalO u hu a := by
+    simp [Coeff.evalO, huStar]
+  change Coeff.evalO u hu (star x).re + Coeff.evalO u hu (star x).im * v =
+    star (Coeff.evalO u hu x.re + Coeff.evalO u hu x.im * v)
+  simp only [QuadraticAlgebra.re_star, QuadraticAlgebra.im_star,
+    map_add, map_mul, map_neg, Coeff.evalO_tau, star_add, star_mul, hr]
+  linear_combination -(Coeff.evalO u hu x.im) * hvStar
+
+private theorem physical_star (x : Coeff.S) :
+    Coeff.physical (star x) = star (Coeff.physical x) := by
+  have hz : zeta ≠ 0 := by
+    intro hz
+    simpa [hz] using Coeff.zeta_norm
+  have hs : zeta + star zeta = -t := by
+    apply mul_left_cancel₀ hz
+    rw [mul_add, Coeff.zeta_norm]
+    linear_combination Coeff.zeta_sq
+  unfold Coeff.physical
+  apply evalS_star t zeta _ _ (by simp [t]) hs
+
+private theorem nonphysical_star (x : Coeff.S) :
+    Coeff.nonphysical (star x) = star (Coeff.nonphysical x) := by
+  have hs : Coeff.conjugateZeta + star Coeff.conjugateZeta = (phi : ℂ) := by
+    apply Complex.ext
+    · simp [Coeff.conjugateZeta, Complex.exp_re, Real.cos_pi_div_five, phi]
+      ring
+    · simp
+  unfold Coeff.nonphysical
+  apply evalS_star (-(phi : ℂ)) Coeff.conjugateZeta _ _ (by simp) (by simpa using hs)
+
+private theorem inc_star (x : Coeff.O) : star (Coeff.inc x) = Coeff.inc x := by
+  apply QuadraticAlgebra.ext
+  · change x + (-Coeff.tau)*0 = x
+    ring
+  · change -(0 : Coeff.O) = 0
+    exact neg_zero
+
+/-- Coefficients for the same original cut after extracting its row factors. -/
+def cutKernel {L : Type} (T : NativeProtocolGraft.Tree L) (I : Finset (Fin 16))
+    (event : Path T → Bool) : Matrix (CutBasis I) (CutBasis I) Coeff.S :=
+  fun i j => ∑ p, ∑ z : CutRest I, if event p then
+    Coeff.inc (Coeff.tau ^ restExponent I z) *
+      cutCoefficient I (Coeff.branch T p Coeff.initial) i z *
+      star (cutCoefficient I (Coeff.branch T p Coeff.initial) j z) else 0
+
+private theorem cutKernel_hermitian {L : Type} (T : NativeProtocolGraft.Tree L)
+    (I : Finset (Fin 16)) (event : Path T → Bool) :
+    (cutKernel T I event)ᴴ = cutKernel T I event := by
+  classical
+  apply Matrix.ext
+  intro i j
+  simp only [Matrix.conjTranspose_apply, cutKernel, star_sum]
+  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
+  intro p _
+  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
+  intro z _
+  split_ifs <;> simp only [star_mul, star_star, inc_star, star_zero] <;> ring
+
+private theorem eventCut_factor {L : Type} (T : NativeProtocolGraft.Tree L)
+    (I : Finset (Fin 16)) (event : Path T → Bool) :
+    eventCut T I event =
+      Matrix.diagonal (fun i => beta^rowExponent I i) *
+        (cutKernel T I event).map Coeff.physical *
+      Matrix.diagonal (fun i => beta^rowExponent I i) := by
+  classical
+  apply Matrix.ext
+  intro i j
+  simp only [Matrix.diagonal_mul, Matrix.mul_diagonal, Matrix.map_apply, cutKernel,
+    map_sum, mul_assoc, Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_mul]
+  simp only [eventCut, Matrix.sum_apply]
+  change (∑ p, (if event p then cutReduced I ((operator T p).mulVec omega0) else 0) i j) = _
+  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
+  intro p _
+  by_cases he : event p
+  · simp only [he, ite_true, map_mul, map_pow, physical_star, cutReduced,
+      D5.S3.Quantum.Information.PartialTraceMutualInformation.partialTraceRight,
+      Matrix.vecMulVec_apply, Function.comp_apply, Pi.star_apply]
+    rw [← (Coeff.original_branch_evaluations T).1 p]
+    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
+    intro z _
+    rw [cut_amplitude, cut_amplitude]
+    have ht : Coeff.physical (Coeff.inc Coeff.tau) = t := by
+      simp [Coeff.physical, Coeff.evalS, Coeff.inc]
+    rw [ht]
+    simp only [star_mul, star_pow, show star beta = beta by simp [beta]]
+    have hb : beta^restExponent I z * beta^restExponent I z = t^restExponent I z := by
+      rw [← mul_pow, ← pow_two, Coeff.beta_sq]
+    linear_combination
+      (beta^rowExponent I i * beta^rowExponent I j *
+        Coeff.physical (cutCoefficient I (Coeff.branch T p Coeff.initial) i z) *
+        star (Coeff.physical (cutCoefficient I (Coeff.branch T p Coeff.initial) j z))) * hb
+  · simp [he]
+
+private theorem fixed_coefficient (x : Coeff.S) (hx : star x = x) :
+    Coeff.inc x.re = x := by
+  have hi : -x.im = x.im := congrArg QuadraticAlgebra.im hx
+  have hir := congrArg QuadraticAlgebra.re hi
+  have hii := congrArg QuadraticAlgebra.im hi
+  have hz : x.im = 0 := by
+    apply QuadraticAlgebra.ext <;> simp only [QuadraticAlgebra.re_neg,
+      QuadraticAlgebra.im_neg, QuadraticAlgebra.re_zero, QuadraticAlgebra.im_zero] at * <;> omega
+  apply QuadraticAlgebra.ext <;> simp [Coeff.inc, hz]
+
+/-- The actual determinant's inverse-golden integer coordinates. -/
+def cutDetCoordinates {L : Type} (T : NativeProtocolGraft.Tree L)
+    (I : Finset (Fin 16)) (event : Path T → Bool) : Coeff.O :=
+  (∏ i : CutBasis I, Coeff.tau^rowExponent I i) * (cutKernel T I event).det.re
+
+
+private def evaluatedCut {L : Type} (f : Coeff.S →+* ℂ) (b : ℂ)
+    (T : NativeProtocolGraft.Tree L) (I : Finset (Fin 16)) (event : Path T → Bool) :
+    Matrix (CutBasis I) (CutBasis I) ℂ :=
+  Matrix.diagonal (fun i => b^rowExponent I i) *
+    (cutKernel T I event).map f * Matrix.diagonal (fun i => b^rowExponent I i)
+
+/-- Apply the chosen nonphysical evaluation to the same integral cut formula.
+Both row factors use beta-prime, without conjugating the second one. -/
+def conjugateEventCut {L : Type} (T : NativeProtocolGraft.Tree L)
+    (I : Finset (Fin 16)) (event : Path T → Bool) :
+    Matrix (CutBasis I) (CutBasis I) ℂ :=
+  evaluatedCut Coeff.nonphysical Coeff.conjugateBeta T I event
+
+private theorem evaluatedCut_det {L : Type} (f : Coeff.S →+* ℂ) (b u : ℂ)
+    (hu : u ^ 2 = 1 - u) (hf : ∀ x, f (Coeff.inc x) = Coeff.evalO u hu x)
+    (hb : b ^ 2 = u) (T : NativeProtocolGraft.Tree L)
+    (I : Finset (Fin 16)) (event : Path T → Bool) :
+    (evaluatedCut f b T I event).det = Coeff.evalO u hu (cutDetCoordinates T I event) := by
+  classical
+  have hx : Coeff.inc (cutKernel T I event).det.re = (cutKernel T I event).det := by
+    apply fixed_coefficient
+    rw [← Matrix.det_conjTranspose, cutKernel_hermitian]
+  have hp : (∏ i : CutBasis I, b^rowExponent I i) *
+      (∏ i : CutBasis I, b^rowExponent I i) = ∏ i : CutBasis I, u^rowExponent I i := by
+    rw [← Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
+    apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
+    intro i _
+    rw [← mul_pow, ← pow_two, hb]
+  have hd : ((cutKernel T I event).map f).det = f (cutKernel T I event).det :=
+    (f.map_det _).symm
+  simp only [evaluatedCut, Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_diagonal]
+  rw [hd, ← hx, hf]
+  unfold cutDetCoordinates
+  simp only [map_mul, map_prod, map_pow, Coeff.evalO_tau]
+  linear_combination Coeff.evalO u hu (cutKernel T I event).det.re * hp
+
+private theorem cut_det_physical {L : Type} (T : NativeProtocolGraft.Tree L)
+    (I : Finset (Fin 16)) (event : Path T → Bool) :
+    (eventCut T I event).det = (Coeff.realPhysical (cutDetCoordinates T I event) : ℂ) := by
+  rw [eventCut_factor]
+  change (evaluatedCut Coeff.physical beta T I event).det = _
+  rw [evaluatedCut_det Coeff.physical beta t Coeff.t_sq
+    (fun x => by simp [Coeff.physical, Coeff.evalS, Coeff.inc]) Coeff.beta_sq]
+  simp [Coeff.realPhysical, Coeff.evalO, t]
+
+private theorem cut_det_conjugate {L : Type} (T : NativeProtocolGraft.Tree L)
+    (I : Finset (Fin 16)) (event : Path T → Bool) :
+    (conjugateEventCut T I event).det =
+      (Coeff.realConjugate (cutDetCoordinates T I event) : ℂ) := by
+  have hb : Coeff.conjugateBeta^2 = -(phi : ℂ) := by
+    simp [Coeff.conjugateBeta, mul_pow, ← Complex.ofReal_pow,
+      Real.sq_sqrt Coeff.phi_positive.le]
+  have hu : (-(phi : ℂ))^2 = 1- (-(phi : ℂ)) := by
+    have hh : phi^2 = phi+1 := Real.goldenRatio_sq
+    exact_mod_cast (by nlinarith only [hh] : (-phi)^2 = 1-(-phi))
+  unfold conjugateEventCut
+  rw [evaluatedCut_det Coeff.nonphysical Coeff.conjugateBeta (-(phi : ℂ)) hu
+    (fun x => by simp [Coeff.nonphysical, Coeff.evalS, Coeff.inc]) hb]
+  simp [Coeff.realConjugate, Coeff.evalO]
+
+
+private theorem cut_conjugate_amplitude (I : Finset (Fin 16)) (h : Basis → Coeff.S)
+    (i : CutBasis I) (z : CutRest I) :
+    Coeff.conjugateAmplitude h ((splitAt I).symm (i,z)) =
+      Coeff.conjugateBeta^rowExponent I i * Coeff.conjugateBeta^restExponent I z *
+        Coeff.nonphysical (cutCoefficient I h i z) := by
+  have hi : rowExponent I i = 0 ∨ rowExponent I i = 1 := by
+    unfold rowExponent; split_ifs <;> simp
+  have hz : restExponent I z = 0 ∨ restExponent I z = 1 := by
+    unfold restExponent; split_ifs <;> simp
+  have ht : Coeff.nonphysical (Coeff.inc Coeff.tau) = -(phi : ℂ) := by
+    simp [Coeff.nonphysical, Coeff.evalS, Coeff.inc]
+  have hb : Coeff.conjugateBeta^2 = -(phi : ℂ) := by
+    simp [Coeff.conjugateBeta, mul_pow, ← Complex.ofReal_pow,
+      Real.sq_sqrt Coeff.phi_positive.le]
+  have he := split_exponent I i z
+  unfold Coeff.conjugateAmplitude cutCoefficient
+  simp only [map_mul, map_pow, map_add, map_one, ht]
+  rw [he]
+  rcases hi with hi | hi <;> rcases hz with hz | hz <;>
+    simp only [hi,hz,Nat.zero_mul,Nat.mul_zero,Nat.one_mul,Nat.mul_one,
+      Nat.zero_add,Nat.add_zero,pow_zero,pow_one,one_mul] <;> norm_num
+  rw [← mul_assoc, ← pow_two, hb]
+  have htq : (-(phi : ℂ))^2 = 1- (-(phi : ℂ)) := by
+    have hh : phi^2 = phi+1 := Real.goldenRatio_sq
+    exact_mod_cast (by nlinarith only [hh] : (-phi)^2 = 1-(-phi))
+  linear_combination -(Coeff.nonphysical (h ((splitAt I).symm (i,z)))) * htq
+
+private theorem conjugateEventCut_signed {L : Type} (T : NativeProtocolGraft.Tree L)
+    (I : Finset (Fin 16)) (event : Path T → Bool) (i j : CutBasis I) :
+    conjugateEventCut T I event i j =

+  rw [reduced, cross,
+    D5.S3.Quantum.Information.PartialTraceMutualInformation.trace_partialTraceRight]
+  simp only [Matrix.trace, Matrix.diag_apply, Matrix.vecMulVec_apply,
+    Function.comp_apply, Pi.star_apply]
+  rw [← (cut : Basis ≃ Fin 2 × Rest).sum_comp]
+  simp only [Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
+  calc
+    (∑ x, v x * star (v x)).re =
+        ∑ x, (v x * star (v x)).re := by
+      exact Complex.re_sum Finset.univ (fun x => v x * star (v x))
+    _ = ∑ x, Complex.normSq (v x) := by
+      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
+      intro x _
+      simp [Complex.normSq_apply, Complex.mul_re, Complex.star_def]
+
+private theorem eventReduced_trace {L : Type} (T : Tree L)
+    (event : Path T → Bool) :
+    (Matrix.trace (eventReduced T event)).re = eventMass T (historyEvent event) := by
+  classical
+  change
+    (Matrix.trace (∑ p, if event p then reduced ((operator T p).mulVec omega0) else 0)).re =
+      ∑ p, ∑ z, if event p then
+        Complex.normSq ((operator T p).mulVec omega0 z) else 0
+  rw [Matrix.trace_sum]
+  calc
+    (∑ p, Matrix.trace (if event p then reduced ((operator T p).mulVec omega0) else 0)).re =
+        ∑ p, (Matrix.trace (if event p then
+          reduced ((operator T p).mulVec omega0) else 0)).re := by
+      exact Complex.re_sum Finset.univ (fun p => Matrix.trace (if event p then
+        reduced ((operator T p).mulVec omega0) else 0))
+    _ = ∑ p, ∑ z, if event p then
+        Complex.normSq ((operator T p).mulVec omega0 z) else 0 := by
+      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
+      intro p _
+      by_cases hp : event p
+      · simp [hp, reduced_trace]
+      · simp [hp]
+
+private theorem ket_cut (x : Basis) (i : Fin 2) (e : Rest) :
+    ket x (cut.symm (i,e)) =
+      if i = (cut x).1 then if e = (cut x).2 then 1 else 0 else 0 := by
+  have h : cut.symm (i,e) = x ↔ i = (cut x).1 ∧ e = (cut x).2 := by
+    rw [Equiv.symm_apply_eq, Prod.ext_iff]
+  simp only [ket, h]
+  split_ifs <;> simp_all
+
+private theorem source_rest (x y z x' y' z' : Bool) :
+    (cut (sourceWord x y z)).2 = (cut (sourceWord x' y' z')).2 ↔
+      y = y' ∧ z = z' := by
+  cases x <;> cases y <;> cases z <;>
+    cases x' <;> cases y' <;> cases z' <;> decide

+/-- The lawful reduction is positive on every actual full-carrier vector. -/
+private theorem reduced_positive (v : Basis → ℂ) : (reduced v).PosSemidef :=
+  D5.S3.Quantum.Information.PartialTraceMutualInformation.partialTraceRight_posSemidef
+    (Matrix.posSemidef_vecMulVec_self_star (v ∘ cut.symm))
+
+private theorem eventReduced_posSemidef {L : Type} (T : Tree L)
+    (event : Path T → Bool) : (eventReduced T event).PosSemidef := by
+  classical
+  unfold eventReduced
+  apply Matrix.posSemidef_sum
+  intro p _
+  split_ifs with hp
+  · exact reduced_positive ((operator T p).mulVec omega0)
+  · exact Matrix.PosSemidef.zero

+private theorem cut_source_bit (x y z : Bool) :
+    (cut (sourceWord x y z)).1 = if x then 1 else 0 := by
+  cases x <;> rfl

+open D5.S3.Quantum.Information.PartialTraceMutualInformation
+
+private theorem cross_add_left (u v w : Basis → ℂ) :
+    cross (u+v) w = cross u w + cross v w := by
+  unfold cross
+  change partialTraceRight
+    (Matrix.vecMulVec ((u ∘ cut.symm)+(v ∘ cut.symm)) (star (w ∘ cut.symm))) = _
+  rw [Matrix.add_vecMulVec, partialTraceRight_add]
+
+private theorem cross_add_right (u v w : Basis → ℂ) :
+    cross u (v+w) = cross u v + cross u w := by
+  unfold cross
+  change partialTraceRight
+    (Matrix.vecMulVec (u ∘ cut.symm) (star ((v ∘ cut.symm)+(w ∘ cut.symm)))) = _
+  rw [star_add, Matrix.vecMulVec_add, partialTraceRight_add]
+
+private theorem cross_ket_smul (a b : ℂ) (x y : Basis) (i j : Fin 2) :
+    cross (a • ket x) (b • ket y) i j =
+      if i = (cut x).1 ∧ j = (cut y).1 ∧ (cut x).2 = (cut y).2
+      then a * star b else 0 := by
+  classical
+  simp only [cross, partialTraceRight, Matrix.vecMulVec_apply,
+    Function.comp_apply, Pi.star_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, map_mul, ket_cut]
+  by_cases hi : i = (cut x).1 <;> by_cases hj : j = (cut y).1 <;>
+    simp [hi, hj, mul_ite, ite_mul, apply_ite (starRingEnd ℂ), eq_comm]
+
+def sourceLocal (i : Fin 2) : ℂ := if i = 0 then a else b
+def p0 : Qubit := fun i j => if i = 0 ∧ j = 0 then 1 else 0
+def sourceMixture : Qubit := fun i j =>
+  (a * star a * b * star b + c * star c) * sourceLocal i * star (sourceLocal j) +
+  (b * star b)^2 * p0 i j
+
+private theorem source_reduction : reduced sourceVector = sourceMixture := by
+  change cross sourceVector sourceVector = _
+  rw [source_steps]
+  simp only [fiveTermVector, cross_add_left, cross_add_right]
+  ext i j
+  simp only [Matrix.add_apply, cross_ket_smul, cut_source_bit, source_rest]
+  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
+    norm_num [sourceMixture, sourceLocal, p0, Matrix.vecMulVec_apply,
+      Pi.star_apply]
+  all_goals simp only [starRingEnd_apply, star_mul, star_pow]
+  · linear_combination
+      (a * star a * c * star c + b^2 * (star b)^2) * Coeff.zeta_norm
+  · linear_combination (a * star b * c * star c) * Coeff.zeta_norm
+  · linear_combination (b * star a * c * star c) * Coeff.zeta_norm
+  · linear_combination (b * star b * c * star c) * Coeff.zeta_norm
+
+private theorem zeta_cube : zeta^3 = t-t*zeta := by
+  calc
+    zeta^3 = zeta*zeta^2 := by ring
+    _ = zeta*(-1-t*zeta) := by rw [Coeff.zeta_sq]
+    _ = -zeta-t*zeta^2 := by ring
+    _ = -zeta-t*(-1-t*zeta) := by rw [Coeff.zeta_sq]
+    _ = t+(t^2-1)*zeta := by ring
+    _ = t-t*zeta := by rw [Coeff.t_sq]; ring
+
+private theorem zeta_four : zeta^4 = t+zeta := by
+  calc
+    zeta^4 = zeta^3*zeta := by ring
+    _ = (t-t*zeta)*zeta := by rw [zeta_cube]
+    _ = t*zeta-t*zeta^2 := by ring
+    _ = t*zeta-t*(-1-t*zeta) := by rw [Coeff.zeta_sq]
+    _ = t+(t+t^2)*zeta := by ring
+    _ = t+zeta := by rw [Coeff.t_sq]; ring
+
+private theorem a_value : a = -t := by
+  unfold a
+  calc
+    _ = zeta+(zeta^2-zeta)*t := by ring
+    _ = zeta+(-1-t*zeta-zeta)*t := by rw [Coeff.zeta_sq]
+    _ = -t := by linear_combination -zeta * Coeff.t_sq
+
+private theorem b_value : b = -beta*zeta^4 := by
+  have hb : beta^3 = beta*t := by rw [pow_succ, Coeff.beta_sq]; ring
+  unfold b
+  rw [hb, zeta_four]
+  calc
+    _ = (zeta^2-zeta)*beta*t := by ring
+    _ = (-1-t*zeta-zeta)*beta*t := by rw [Coeff.zeta_sq]
+    _ = -beta*(t+zeta) := by linear_combination -(beta*zeta) * Coeff.t_sq
+
+private theorem c_value : c = -t*zeta^3 := by
+  unfold c
+  rw [Coeff.t_sq, zeta_cube]
+  calc
+    _ = zeta^2-(zeta+(zeta^2-zeta)*t)+zeta := by ring
+    _ = -1-t*zeta-(-t)+zeta := by
+      rw [show zeta+(zeta^2-zeta)*t = a by unfold a; ring,
+        a_value, Coeff.zeta_sq]
+    _ = -t*(t-t*zeta) := by linear_combination (1-zeta)*Coeff.t_sq
+
+theorem star_t : star t = t := by simp [t]
+theorem star_beta : star beta = beta := by simp [beta]
+private theorem phase_norm (n : ℕ) : zeta^n * star (zeta^n) = 1 := by
+  rw [star_pow, ← mul_pow, Coeff.zeta_norm, one_pow]
+
+theorem a_norm : a * star a = t^2 := by
+  rw [a_value, star_neg, star_t]; ring
+theorem b_norm : b * star b = t := by
+  rw [b_value, star_mul, star_neg, star_beta]
+  calc
+    _ = beta^2 * (zeta^4*star (zeta^4)) := by ring
+    _ = t := by rw [phase_norm, Coeff.beta_sq, mul_one]
+theorem c_norm : c * star c = t^2 := by
+  rw [c_value, star_mul, star_neg, star_t]
+  calc
+    _ = t^2*(zeta^3*star (zeta^3)) := by ring
+    _ = t^2 := by rw [phase_norm, mul_one]
+
+def gamma : ℂ := t^2 * beta * star (zeta^4)
+def chi : Qubit := !![t,gamma;star gamma,t^2]
+
+private theorem mixture_chi : sourceMixture = chi := by
+  have hw : a * star a * b * star b + c * star c = t := by
+    rw [show a * star a * b * star b = (a*star a)*(b*star b) by ring,
+      a_norm, b_norm, c_norm]
+    linear_combination t * Coeff.t_sq
+  ext i j
+  simp only [sourceMixture, hw, b_norm]
+  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
+    norm_num [sourceLocal, p0, chi, Matrix.vecMulVec_apply, Pi.star_apply]
+  all_goals try simp only [starRingEnd_apply]
+  · rw [show t*a*star a = t*(a*star a) by ring, a_norm]
+    linear_combination t*Coeff.t_sq
+  · rw [a_value, b_value, star_mul, star_neg, star_beta]
+    unfold gamma
+    ring
+  · rw [a_value, b_value, star_neg, star_t]
+    simp only [gamma, star_mul, star_pow, star_t, star_beta, star_star, starRingEnd_apply]
+    ring
+  · rw [show t*b*star b = t*(b*star b) by ring, b_norm]
+    ring
+
+/-- The full-carrier source calls give exactly the same native marginal chi. -/
+private theorem original_source_calibration :
+    reduced ((operator sourceTree ()).mulVec omega0) = chi ∧ chi.PosSemidef := by
+  have hv := original_source_vector.1
+  have hc : reduced ((operator sourceTree ()).mulVec omega0) = chi := by
+    rw [hv, ← source_steps, source_reduction, mixture_chi]
+  exact ⟨hc, hc ▸ reduced_positive _⟩
+

+
+private theorem t_nonzero : t ≠ 0 := by
+  exact Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (inv_ne_zero Coeff.phi_positive.ne')
+
+private theorem gamma_norm : gamma * star gamma = t^5 := by
+  simp only [gamma, star_mul, star_pow, star_t, star_beta, star_star]
+  calc
+    _ = t^4 * beta^2 * (zeta^4 * star (zeta^4)) := by rw [star_pow]; ring
+    _ = t^5 := by rw [phase_norm, Coeff.beta_sq]; ring
+
+private theorem chi_det : chi.det = t^4 := by
+  rw [Matrix.det_fin_two]
+  change t * t^2 - gamma * star gamma = t^4
+  rw [gamma_norm]
+  linear_combination -(t^3)*Coeff.t_sq
+
+private theorem chi_trace : chi.trace = 1 := by
+  simp only [chi, Matrix.trace, Fin.sum_univ_two]
+  norm_num
+  linear_combination Coeff.t_sq
+
+private theorem chi_faithful : chi.PosDef :=
+  original_source_calibration.2.posDef_iff_det_ne_zero.mpr
+    (chi_det ▸ pow_ne_zero 4 t_nonzero)
+
+private theorem empty_reduction : reduced omega0 = p0 := by
+  rw [source_start]
+  change cross (ket (sourceWord false false true))
+    (ket (sourceWord false false true)) = _
+  rw [← one_smul ℂ (ket (sourceWord false false true))]
+  ext i j
+  rw [cross_ket_smul, cut_source_bit]
+  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> norm_num [p0]
+
+def rootScale : ℝ := Real.sqrt (1+2*(phi⁻¹)^2)
+def chiRoot : Qubit := (rootScale : ℂ)⁻¹ • (chi + t^2 • (1 : Qubit))
+
+private theorem rootScale_pos : 0 < rootScale := by
+  dsimp [rootScale]
+  positivity
+
+private theorem rootScale_sq : (rootScale : ℂ)^2 = 1+2*t^2 := by
+  dsimp [rootScale, t]
+  norm_cast
+  exact Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)
+
+private theorem chi_square : chi*chi = chi-t^4 • (1 : Qubit) := by
+  ext i j
+  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
+    norm_num [chi, Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two,
+      Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, star_t, star_pow]
+  all_goals try simp only [starRingEnd_apply]
+  · rw [gamma_norm]
+    linear_combination (t^3+t)*Coeff.t_sq
+  · linear_combination gamma*Coeff.t_sq
+  · linear_combination (star gamma)*Coeff.t_sq
+  · rw [mul_comm (star gamma) gamma, gamma_norm]
+    linear_combination (t^3+t^2)*Coeff.t_sq
+
+private theorem chiRoot_square : chiRoot*chiRoot = chi := by
+  have hn : (rootScale : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr rootScale_pos.ne'
+  have hnum : (chi+t^2 • (1 : Qubit)) * (chi+t^2 • (1 : Qubit)) =
+      (1+2*t^2) • chi := by
+    rw [Matrix.add_mul, Matrix.mul_add, Matrix.mul_add, chi_square]
+    simp only [Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.smul_mul, Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.mul_one,
+      smul_smul]
+    module
+  rw [chiRoot, Matrix.smul_mul, Matrix.mul_smul, smul_smul, hnum, smul_smul]
+  have hc : (rootScale : ℂ)⁻¹*(rootScale : ℂ)⁻¹*(1+2*t^2) = 1 := by
+    rw [← rootScale_sq]
+    field_simp
+  rw [hc, one_smul]
+
+private theorem chiRoot_positive : chiRoot.PosSemidef := by
+  apply Matrix.PosSemidef.smul
+  · exact original_source_calibration.2.add
+      (Matrix.PosSemidef.one.smul (by
+        simp only [t, ← Complex.ofReal_pow, Complex.nonneg_iff, Complex.ofReal_re,
+          Complex.ofReal_im, and_true]
+        positivity))
+  · exact_mod_cast (inv_nonneg.mpr rootScale_pos.le : 0 ≤ rootScale⁻¹)
+
+private theorem chi_sqrt : cfc Real.sqrt chi = chiRoot := by
+  have h : CFC.sqrt chi = chiRoot :=
+    CFC.sqrt_unique chiRoot_square chiRoot_positive.nonneg
+  rwa [CFC.sqrt_eq_real_sqrt _ original_source_calibration.2.nonneg,
+    cfcₙ_eq_cfc] at h
+

+/-- The same original b1 instrument, after summing its retained read. -/
+def delta (X : Qubit) : Qubit := Matrix.diagonal (fun i => X i i)
+
+private theorem read_cut (i : Fin 2) (e : Rest) :
+    readBit 2 (cut.symm (i,e)) = i := by
+  fin_cases i <;> rfl
+
+private theorem projected_cut (v : Basis → ℂ) (j i : Fin 2) (e : Rest) :
+    ((projector (readBit 2) j).mulVec v) (cut.symm (i,e)) =
+      if i = j then v (cut.symm (i,e)) else 0 := by
+  simp [projector, Matrix.mulVec_diagonal, read_cut]
+
+private theorem reduced_projector (v : Basis → ℂ) (o : Fin 2) :
+    reduced ((projector (readBit 2) o).mulVec v) =
+      fun i j => if i = o ∧ j = o then reduced v i j else 0 := by
+  ext i j
+  simp only [reduced, cross, partialTraceRight, Matrix.vecMulVec_apply,
+    Function.comp_apply, Pi.star_apply, projected_cut]
+  by_cases hi : i = o <;> by_cases hj : j = o <;>
+    simp [hi, hj, apply_ite (starRingEnd ℂ)]
+
+private theorem native_delta (v : Basis → ℂ) :
+    (∑ j : Fin 2, reduced ((projector (readBit 2) j).mulVec v)) =
+      delta (reduced v) := by
+  rw [Fin.sum_univ_two, reduced_projector, reduced_projector]
+  ext i j
+  change (if i = 0 ∧ j = 0 then reduced v i j else 0) +
+    (if i = 1 ∧ j = 1 then reduced v i j else 0) =
+    if i = j then reduced v i i else 0
+  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp
+
+private theorem read_empty (j : Fin 2) :
+    (projector (readBit 2) j).mulVec omega0 =
+      if j = 0 then omega0 else 0 := by
+  funext z
+  simp only [projector, Matrix.mulVec_diagonal, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
+    Pi.zero_apply]
+  by_cases hz : z = rootWord
+  · subst z
+    fin_cases j <;> norm_num [omega0, readBit, rootWord]
+  · by_cases hj : j = 0 <;> simp [omega0, hz, hj]
+
+def inverseRoot : Qubit := Matrix.diagonal ![beta⁻¹,t⁻¹]
+
+private theorem h_diagonal :
+    delta chi = Matrix.diagonal (fun i => ((![(phi⁻¹),(phi⁻¹)^2] : Fin 2 → ℝ) i : ℂ)) := by
+  ext i j
+  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp [delta, chi, t]
+
+private theorem inverse_root :
+    cfc (fun x : ℝ => (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹) (delta chi) = inverseRoot := by
+  rw [h_diagonal,
+    D5.S3.Quantum.Dynamics.EntropyProductionCoherenceDeletionIdentity.cfc_diagonal]
+  ext i j
+  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
+    simp [inverseRoot, beta, t, Real.sqrt_sq (inv_nonneg.mpr Coeff.phi_positive.le),
+      Real.sqrt_sq Coeff.phi_positive.le]
+
+/-- The fixed mathematical Petz formula. This definition adds no native gate. -/
+def petz (Y : Qubit) : Qubit :=
+  cfc Real.sqrt chi *
+    delta (cfc (fun x : ℝ => (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹) (delta chi) * Y *
+      cfc (fun x : ℝ => (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹) (delta chi)) *
+    cfc Real.sqrt chi
+
+private theorem petz_empty_entry :
+    petz p0 1 1 = t^4/(1+2*t^2) := by
+  have hb : beta ≠ 0 := by
+    intro h
+    have hs := Coeff.beta_sq
+    rw [h, zero_pow (by decide)] at hs
+    exact t_nonzero hs.symm
+  have hr : (rootScale : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr rootScale_pos.ne'
+  have hd : 1+2*t^2 ≠ 0 := by rw [← rootScale_sq]; exact pow_ne_zero 2 hr
+  rw [petz, chi_sqrt, inverse_root]
+  norm_num [Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two, chiRoot, inverseRoot,
+    delta, p0, chi, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
+  simp only [starRingEnd_apply]
+  have hg : star gamma * gamma = t^5 := by rw [mul_comm, gamma_norm]
+  calc
+    _ = (star gamma * gamma) / ((rootScale : ℂ)^2 * beta^2) := by field_simp <;> ring
+    _ = t^4/(1+2*t^2) := by
+      rw [hg, rootScale_sq, Coeff.beta_sq]
+      field_simp <;> ring
+
+private theorem empty_target_value :
+    ((emptyTarget : ℝ) : ℂ) = t^4/(1+2*t^2) := by
+  have hi : phi⁻¹ = phi-1 := by
+    change Real.goldenRatio⁻¹ = Real.goldenRatio-1
+    rw [Real.inv_goldenRatio]
+    dsimp [Real.goldenConj, Real.goldenRatio]
+    ring
+  have he : ((emptyTarget : ℝ) : ℂ) = (4-5*t)/11 := by
+    simp only [t, emptyTarget, Complex.ofReal_div, Complex.ofReal_sub,
+      Complex.ofReal_mul, Complex.ofReal_ofNat]
+    rw [hi]
+    push_cast
+    dsimp [phi]
+    push_cast
+    ring
+  rw [he]
+  have hd : 1+2*t^2 ≠ 0 := by
+    rw [← rootScale_sq]
+    exact pow_ne_zero 2 (Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr rootScale_pos.ne')
+  apply (eq_div_iff hd).2
+  rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div]
+  apply (div_eq_iff (by norm_num : (11 : ℂ) ≠ 0)).2
+  linear_combination -(11*t^2-t+4)*Coeff.t_sq
+

+/-- The actual three-call calibration, native read and fixed Petz empty-input
+event are linked to every complete original continuation's raw discrepancy.

+theorem original_empty_petz_consumer :
+    reduced ((operator sourceTree ()).mulVec omega0) = chi ∧

+    cfc Real.sqrt chi = chiRoot ∧

+  have hp : petz (reduced omega0) 1 1 = ((emptyTarget : ℝ) : ℂ) := by

+/-! The first proved bridge toward V88 theorem 24.1: at the actual original
+b1 cut, a history event supplies its unnormalized positive reduced matrix and
+the exact raw trace. The determinant and full-rank spectral clauses remain
+separate obligations. -/

+
+/-- Evaluation laws follow from the two defining quadratic equations. -/
+def evalO {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (u : R) (hu : u ^ 2 = 1 - u) : O →+* R where
+  toFun x := (x.re : R) + (x.im : R) * u
+  map_zero' := by simp
+  map_one' := by
+    simp only [QuadraticAlgebra.re_one, QuadraticAlgebra.im_one, Int.cast_one,
+      Int.cast_zero, zero_mul, add_zero]
+  map_add' x y := by
+    change (((x+y).re : R) + ((x+y).im : R) * u) = _
+    simp only [QuadraticAlgebra.re_add, QuadraticAlgebra.im_add, Int.cast_add]
+    ring
+  map_mul' x y := by
+    change (((x*y).re : R) + ((x*y).im : R) * u) = _
+    simp only [QuadraticAlgebra.re_mul, QuadraticAlgebra.im_mul]
+    push_cast
+    linear_combination -(x.im : R) * (y.im : R) * hu
+
+@[simp] theorem evalO_tau {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (u : R) (hu : u ^ 2 = 1 - u) :
+    evalO u hu tau = u := by simp [evalO, tau, QuadraticAlgebra.omega]
+
+def evalS (u v : ℂ) (hu : u ^ 2 = 1 - u) (hv : v ^ 2 = -1 - u*v) : S →+* ℂ where
+  toFun x := evalO u hu x.re + evalO u hu x.im * v
+  map_zero' := by simp
+  map_one' := by change evalO u hu 1 + evalO u hu 0 * v = 1; simp
+  map_add' x y := by
+    change evalO u hu (x+y).re + evalO u hu (x+y).im * v = _
+    simp only [QuadraticAlgebra.re_add, QuadraticAlgebra.im_add, map_add]
+    ring
+  map_mul' x y := by
+    change evalO u hu (x*y).re + evalO u hu (x*y).im * v = _
+    simp only [QuadraticAlgebra.re_mul, QuadraticAlgebra.im_mul,
+      map_add, map_mul, map_neg, map_one, evalO_tau]
+    linear_combination -(evalO u hu x.im) * (evalO u hu y.im) * hv
+
+def physical : S →+* ℂ := evalS t zeta t_sq zeta_sq
+
+@[simp] private theorem evalS_inc (u v : ℂ) (hu hv) (x : O) :
+    evalS u v hu hv (inc x) = evalO u hu x := by
+  simp [evalS, inc]
+@[simp] private theorem evalS_eta (u v : ℂ) (hu hv) :
+    evalS u v hu hv eta = v := by simp [evalS, eta, QuadraticAlgebra.omega]
+
+/-- Relative bit parity on the entire sixteen-bit carrier. -/
+def parity (b : Basis) : ZMod 2 :=
+  (∑ i : Fin 16, if b i then 1 else 0) -
+    ∑ i : Fin 16, if rootWord i then 1 else 0
+
+def exponent (b : Basis) : ℕ := if parity b = 0 then 0 else 1
+
+private theorem parity_root : parity rootWord = 0 := by simp [parity]
+theorem flip_flip (i : Fin 16) (b : Basis) : flip i (flip i b) = b := by
+  funext k
+  by_cases hk : k = i
+  · subst k; simp [flip]
+  · simp [flip, Function.update_of_ne hk, hk]
+
+private theorem parity_flip (i : Fin 16) (b : Basis) :
+    parity (flip i b) = parity b + 1 := by
+  classical
+  have hsplit (f : Fin 16 → ZMod 2) :
+      ∑ k, f k = (∑ k ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, f k) + f i :=
+    (Finset.sum_erase_add _ _ (Finset.mem_univ i)).symm
+  unfold parity
+  rw [hsplit (fun k => if flip i b k then 1 else 0),
+    hsplit (fun k => if b k then 1 else 0)]
+  have he : (∑ k ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, if flip i b k then (1:ZMod 2) else 0) =
+      ∑ k ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, if b k then 1 else 0 := by
+    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
+    intro k hk
+    simp [flip, Function.update_of_ne (Finset.mem_erase.mp hk).1]
+  rw [he]
+  cases hb : b i <;> simp [flip, hb] <;> ring_nf <;> simp only [mod_two, zero_add]
+
+private theorem exponent_flip (i : Fin 16) (b : Basis) :
+    exponent (flip i b) = 1 - exponent b := by
+  have hcases : parity b = 0 ∨ parity b = 1 := by
+    have hv := (parity b).val_lt
+    have hr := ZMod.natCast_zmod_val (parity b)
+    interval_cases (parity b).val <;> simp_all
+  rcases hcases with h | h <;> norm_num [exponent, parity_flip, h] <;> exact mod_two
+
+
+private theorem number_action (i : Fin 16) (w : Basis → ℂ) (z : Basis) :
+    (number i).mulVec w z = if z i then w z else 0 := by
+  classical
+  simp [number, Matrix.mulVec_diagonal]
+
+private theorem complement_action (i : Fin 16) (w : Basis → ℂ) (z : Basis) :
+    (1 - number i : Mat).mulVec w z = if z i then 0 else w z := by
+  rw [Matrix.sub_mulVec, Pi.sub_apply, Matrix.one_mulVec, number_action]
+  cases z i <;> simp
+
+private theorem flip_action (i : Fin 16) (w : Basis → ℂ) (z : Basis) :
+    (bitX i).mulVec w z = w (flip i z) := by
+  classical
+  have he (b : Basis) : z = flip i b ↔ b = flip i z := by
+    constructor
+    · intro h; rw [h, flip_flip]
+    · intro h; rw [h, flip_flip]
+  simp [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, bitX, he]
+
+private theorem q_action (j : Address) (w : Basis → ℂ) (z : Basis) :
+    (goldenQ j).mulVec w z =
+      (if z (center j) then t^2 else t) * w z + beta^3 * w (flip (center j) z) := by
+  simp only [goldenQ, Matrix.add_mulVec, Matrix.smul_mulVec,
+    Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, number_action, complement_action]
+  rw [flip_action]
+  cases z (center j) <;> simp
+
+def diagonal (j : Address) (z : Basis) : O :=
+  if z (left j) then (if z (right j) then 1 else 0)
+  else if z (right j) then 0 else if z (center j) then tau^2 else tau
+
+def active (j : Address) (z : Basis) : Bool := !(z (left j)) && !(z (right j))
+
+def diagStep (j : Address) (z : Basis) : S :=
+  eta * (1 + (eta - 1) * inc (diagonal j z))
+def offStep (j : Address) (z : Basis) : S :=
+  if active j z then inc tau * eta * (eta - 1) else 0
+
+/-- A forward call transports four integer coefficients per basis word. -/
+def step (j : Address) (h : Basis → S) (z : Basis) : S :=
+  diagStep j z * h z +
+    offStep j z * inc (tau ^ (1 - exponent z)) * h (flip (center j) z)
+
+def amplitude (h : Basis → S) (z : Basis) : ℂ :=
+  beta ^ exponent z * physical (h z)
+
+theorem p_action (j : Address) (w : Basis → ℂ) (z : Basis) :
+    (goldenP j).mulVec w z = evalO t t_sq (diagonal j z) * w z +
+      (if active j z then beta^3 * w (flip (center j) z) else 0) := by
+  simp only [goldenP, Matrix.add_mulVec, ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Pi.add_apply]
+  rw [number_action, complement_action]
+  cases hl : z (left j) <;> cases hr : z (right j) <;>
+    simp [diagonal, active, hl, hr, number_action, complement_action, q_action]
+  cases z (center j) <;> simp
+
+private theorem step_physical (j : Address) (h : Basis → S) :
+    amplitude (step j h) = (gate j).mulVec (amplitude h) := by
+  funext z
+  have he : exponent z = 0 ∨ exponent z = 1 := by
+    unfold exponent; split_ifs <;> simp
+  have hpow := exponent_flip (center j) z
+  simp only [gate, Matrix.smul_mulVec, Matrix.add_mulVec, Matrix.one_mulVec,
+    Pi.smul_apply, Pi.add_apply, smul_eq_mul, p_action]
+  unfold amplitude step diagStep offStep physical
+  simp only [map_add, map_mul, map_sub, map_one, evalS_eta, evalS_inc, map_pow,
+    evalO_tau, map_zero]
+  rw [hpow]
+  rcases he with he | he <;> rw [he] <;>
+    cases ha : active j z <;> simp [ha, beta_sq] <;> ring_nf <;>
+    try simp only [show beta^4 = t^2 by rw [show beta^4 = (beta^2)^2 by ring, beta_sq],
+      show beta^3 = beta*t by rw [pow_succ, beta_sq]; ring]
+  all_goals ring
+
+/-- Complete finite branch transport, with nine steps at inverse syntax. -/
+def branch {L : Type} : (T : Tree L) → Path T → (Basis → S) → Basis → S
+  | .leaf _, _, h => h
+  | .call j d U, p, h => branch U p ((step j)^[callCost d] h)
+  | .measure _ select U, p, h =>
+      branch (U p.1) p.2 (fun z => if select z = p.1 then h z else 0)
+
+def initial : Basis → S := fun z => if z = rootWord then 1 else 0
+
+private theorem initial_physical : amplitude initial = omega0 := by
+  funext z
+  by_cases hz : z = rootWord
+  · subst z
+    simp [amplitude, initial, omega0, exponent, parity_root]
+  · simp [amplitude, initial, omega0, hz]
+
+private theorem iterate_physical (j : Address) (n : ℕ) (h : Basis → S) :
+    amplitude ((step j)^[n] h) = (gate j ^ n).mulVec (amplitude h) := by
+  induction n generalizing h with
+  | zero => simp
+  | succ n ih =>
+    rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply, ih, step_physical,
+      Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, ← pow_succ]
+
+private theorem branch_physical {L : Type} (T : Tree L) (p : Path T) (h : Basis → S) :
+    amplitude (branch T p h) = (operator T p).mulVec (amplitude h) := by
+  induction T generalizing h with
+  | leaf l => simp [branch, operator]
+  | call j d U ih =>
+    change amplitude (branch U p ((step j)^[callCost d] h)) =
+      (operator U p * callMatrix j d).mulVec (amplitude h)
+    rw [ih p, iterate_physical, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec]
+    cases d <;> simp [operator, callMatrix, callCost]
+  | measure n select U ih =>
+    change amplitude (branch (U p.1) p.2 _) =
+      (operator (U p.1) p.2 * projector select p.1).mulVec (amplitude h)
+    rw [ih p.1 p.2]
+    simp only [← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec]
+    congr 1
+    funext z
+    simp [amplitude, projector, Matrix.mulVec_diagonal]
+    split_ifs <;> simp
+
+
+private theorem real_t_sq : (phi⁻¹ : ℝ)^2 = 1 - phi⁻¹ := by
+  change Real.goldenRatio⁻¹ ^ 2 = 1 - Real.goldenRatio⁻¹
+  rw [Real.inv_goldenRatio]
+  nlinarith [Real.goldenConj_sq]
+
+private theorem neg_phi_sq : (-phi)^2 = 1 - (-phi) := by
+  change (-Real.goldenRatio)^2 = 1 - (-Real.goldenRatio)
+  nlinarith [Real.goldenRatio_sq]
+
+private theorem complex_neg_phi_sq : (-(phi : ℂ))^2 = 1 - (-(phi : ℂ)) := by
+  exact_mod_cast neg_phi_sq
+
+def realPhysical : O →+* ℝ := evalO phi⁻¹ real_t_sq
+def realConjugate : O →+* ℝ := evalO (-phi) neg_phi_sq
+
+def conjugateZeta : ℂ := Complex.exp ((Real.pi / 5 : ℝ) * Complex.I)
+def conjugateBeta : ℂ := (Real.sqrt phi : ℂ) * Complex.I
+
+private theorem conjugateZeta_re : 2 * conjugateZeta.re = phi := by
+  simp [conjugateZeta, Complex.exp_re, Real.cos_pi_div_five, phi]
+  ring
+
+private theorem conjugateZeta_norm : Complex.normSq conjugateZeta = 1 := by
+  rw [Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq]
+  simp [conjugateZeta, Complex.norm_exp]
+
+private theorem conjugateZeta_sq : conjugateZeta^2 = -1 - (-(phi : ℂ))*conjugateZeta := by
+  have hs : conjugateZeta + star conjugateZeta = (phi : ℂ) := by
+    apply Complex.ext
+    · simpa [two_mul] using conjugateZeta_re
+    · simp
+  have hn : conjugateZeta * star conjugateZeta = 1 := by
+    change conjugateZeta * (starRingEnd ℂ) conjugateZeta = 1
+    rw [Complex.mul_conj, conjugateZeta_norm]; rfl
+  have h := congrArg (fun x : ℂ => conjugateZeta*x) hs
+  rw [mul_add, hn] at h
+  linear_combination h
+
+private theorem conjugateBeta_sq : conjugateBeta^2 = -(phi : ℂ) := by
+  have hp : 0 ≤ phi := by dsimp [phi]; positivity
+  simp [conjugateBeta, mul_pow, ← Complex.ofReal_pow, Real.sq_sqrt hp]
+
+private theorem conjugateBeta_norm : Complex.normSq conjugateBeta = phi := by
+  have hp : 0 ≤ phi := by dsimp [phi]; positivity
+  simp only [conjugateBeta, map_mul, Complex.normSq_I, Complex.normSq_ofReal]
+  rw [← pow_two, Real.sq_sqrt hp, mul_one]
+
+def nonphysical : S →+* ℂ :=
+  evalS (-(phi : ℂ)) conjugateZeta complex_neg_phi_sq conjugateZeta_sq
+
+def conjugateAmplitude (h : Basis → S) (z : Basis) : ℂ :=
+  conjugateBeta ^ exponent z * nonphysical (h z)
+
+private theorem evalO_real (u : ℝ) (hu : u^2 = 1-u) (x : O) :
+    evalO (u : ℂ) (by exact_mod_cast hu) x = (evalO u hu x : ℂ) := by
+  simp [evalO]
+
+private theorem norm_evaluation (u : ℝ) (v : ℂ) (hu : u^2 = 1-u)
+    (hv : v^2 = -1 - (u : ℂ)*v) (hr : 2*v.re = -u)
+    (hn : Complex.normSq v = 1) (x : S) :
+    evalO u hu (QuadraticAlgebra.norm x) =
+      Complex.normSq (evalS (u : ℂ) v (by exact_mod_cast hu) hv x) := by
+  simp only [QuadraticAlgebra.norm_def, map_sub, map_add, map_mul, map_neg,
+    map_one, evalO_tau]
+  change _ = Complex.normSq ((evalO (u : ℂ) _ x.re) +
+    (evalO (u : ℂ) _ x.im)*v)
+  rw [evalO_real u hu x.re, evalO_real u hu x.im]
+  simp only [Complex.normSq_apply, Complex.add_re, Complex.add_im, Complex.mul_re,
+    Complex.mul_im, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im, zero_mul, sub_zero,
+    zero_add, add_zero]
+  rw [Complex.normSq_apply] at hn
+  linear_combination -(evalO u hu x.im)^2 * hn -
+    evalO u hu x.re * evalO u hu x.im * hr
+
+/-- Integer coordinates of the raw event, computed from the same branch products. -/
+def coordinates {L : Type} (T : Tree L) (event : Path T → Basis → Bool) : O :=
+  ∑ p, ∑ z, if event p z then
+    tau ^ exponent z * QuadraticAlgebra.norm (branch T p initial z) else 0
+
+private theorem physical_coordinate (h : Basis → S) (z : Basis) :
+    realPhysical (tau^exponent z * QuadraticAlgebra.norm (h z)) =
+      Complex.normSq (amplitude h z) := by
+  have hr : 2*zeta.re = -phi⁻¹ := by
+    have hh := congrArg Complex.re zeta_sum
+    simpa [t, two_mul] using hh
+  have hn : Complex.normSq zeta = 1 := by
+    have hh := zeta_norm
+    change zeta * (starRingEnd ℂ) zeta = 1 at hh
+    rw [Complex.mul_conj] at hh
+    exact_mod_cast hh
+  have hb : Complex.normSq beta = phi⁻¹ := by
+    simp only [beta, Complex.normSq_ofReal]
+    rw [← pow_two, Real.sq_sqrt]
+    exact inv_nonneg.mpr (by dsimp [phi]; positivity)
+  simp only [realPhysical, map_mul, map_pow, evalO_tau, amplitude,
+    map_mul, map_pow, hb, physical]
+  rw [norm_evaluation phi⁻¹ zeta real_t_sq (by simpa [t] using zeta_sq) hr hn]
+  rfl
+
+private theorem conjugate_coordinate (h : Basis → S) (z : Basis) :
+    realConjugate (tau^exponent z * QuadraticAlgebra.norm (h z)) =
+      (-1 : ℝ)^exponent z * Complex.normSq (conjugateAmplitude h z) := by
+  simp only [realConjugate, map_mul, map_pow, evalO_tau, conjugateAmplitude,
+    map_mul, map_pow, conjugateBeta_norm, nonphysical]
+  rw [norm_evaluation (-phi) conjugateZeta neg_phi_sq
+    (by simpa using conjugateZeta_sq) (by simpa using conjugateZeta_re) conjugateZeta_norm]
+  by_cases he : exponent z = 0
+  · simp [he]
+  · have he' : exponent z = 1 := by simpa [exponent] using he
+    simp [he', mul_assoc]
+
+private theorem coordinates_physical {L : Type} (T : Tree L)
+    (event : Path T → Basis → Bool) :
+    realPhysical (coordinates T event) = eventMass T event := by
+  classical
+  simp only [coordinates, map_sum, eventMass]
+  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
+  intro p _
+  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
+  intro z _
+  split_ifs with h
+  · rw [physical_coordinate, branch_physical, initial_physical]
+    rfl
+  · exact map_zero _
+
+private theorem coordinates_conjugate {L : Type} (T : Tree L)
+    (event : Path T → Basis → Bool) :
+    realConjugate (coordinates T event) = ∑ p, ∑ z, if event p z then
+      (-1 : ℝ)^exponent z * Complex.normSq (conjugateAmplitude (branch T p initial) z)
+      else 0 := by
+  classical
+  simp only [coordinates, map_sum]
+  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
+  intro p _
+  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
+  intro z _
+  split_ifs
+  · exact conjugate_coordinate _ _
+  · exact map_zero _
+
+
+/-- The actual embedded projection row, derived from the same coefficient transport. -/
+def conjugateP (j : Address) (w : Basis → ℂ) (z : Basis) : ℂ :=
+  (realConjugate (diagonal j z) : ℂ) * w z +
+    if active j z then conjugateBeta^3 * w (flip (center j) z) else 0
+
+private theorem conjugate_step (j : Address) (h : Basis → S) (z : Basis) :
+    conjugateAmplitude (step j h) z = conjugateZeta *
+      (conjugateAmplitude h z + (conjugateZeta - 1) *
+        conjugateP j (conjugateAmplitude h) z) := by
+  have he : exponent z = 0 ∨ exponent z = 1 := by
+    unfold exponent; split_ifs <;> simp
+  have hpow := exponent_flip (center j) z
+  unfold conjugateAmplitude step diagStep offStep nonphysical conjugateP
+  simp only [map_add, map_mul, map_sub, map_one, evalS_eta, evalS_inc, map_pow,
+    evalO_tau]
+  rw [hpow]
+  have hd : evalO (-(phi : ℂ)) complex_neg_phi_sq (diagonal j z) =
+      (realConjugate (diagonal j z) : ℂ) := by
+    simpa [realConjugate] using evalO_real (-phi) neg_phi_sq (diagonal j z)
+  rw [hd]
+  rcases he with he | he <;> rw [he] <;>
+    cases ha : active j z <;> simp [ha] <;> ring_nf <;>
+    try simp only [show conjugateBeta^4 = (-(phi : ℂ))^2 by
+      rw [show conjugateBeta^4 = (conjugateBeta^2)^2 by ring, conjugateBeta_sq],
+      show conjugateBeta^3 = conjugateBeta * (-(phi : ℂ)) by
+        rw [pow_succ, conjugateBeta_sq]; ring]
+  all_goals ring
+
+def energy (w : Basis → ℂ) : ℝ := ∑ z, Complex.normSq (w z)
+def l2 (w : Basis → ℂ) : EuclideanSpace ℂ Basis := WithLp.toLp 2 w
+
+private theorem energy_nonneg (w : Basis → ℂ) : 0 ≤ energy w :=
+  Finset.sum_nonneg (fun _ _ => Complex.normSq_nonneg _)
+
+private theorem energy_norm (w : Basis → ℂ) : energy w = ‖l2 w‖^2 := by
+  simp [energy, l2, EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq, Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq]
+
+private theorem cauchy_two (a b x y : ℂ) :
+    Complex.normSq (a*x+b*y) ≤
+      (Complex.normSq a+Complex.normSq b)*(Complex.normSq x+Complex.normSq y) := by
+  have h := norm_add_le (a*x) (b*y)
+  rw [norm_mul, norm_mul] at h
+  have hs := sq_nonneg (‖a‖*‖y‖ - ‖b‖*‖x‖)
+  simp only [Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq]
+  nlinarith [norm_nonneg (a*x+b*y), norm_nonneg a, norm_nonneg b,
+    norm_nonneg x, norm_nonneg y]
+
+theorem flip_sum (i : Fin 16) (f : Basis → ℝ) :
+    ∑ z, f (flip i z) = ∑ z, f z := by
+  let e : Basis ≃ Basis := ⟨flip i, flip i, flip_flip i, flip_flip i⟩
+  exact e.sum_comp f
+
+theorem phi_positive : 0 < phi := by dsimp [phi]; positivity
+private theorem phi_cubic : phi^3 = phi + phi^2 := by
+  have h : phi^2 = phi+1 := Real.goldenRatio_sq
+  nlinarith
+
+theorem active_flip (j : Address) (z : Basis) :
+    active j (flip (center j) z) = active j z := by
+  have hl : left j ≠ center j := by
+    intro h; have hh := congrArg Fin.val h; simp [left, center] at hh
+  have hr : right j ≠ center j := by
+    intro h; have hh := congrArg Fin.val h; simp [right, center] at hh
+  simp [active, flip, Function.update_of_ne hl, Function.update_of_ne hr, hl, hr]
+
+/-- Squared row weight on a nonphysical active two-dimensional block. -/
+def rowWeight (j : Address) (z : Basis) : ℝ :=
+  if z (center j) then phi^2 else phi
+
+private theorem rowWeight_pair (j : Address) (z : Basis) :
+    rowWeight j z + rowWeight j (flip (center j) z) = phi^3 := by
+  cases hc : z (center j) <;> simp [rowWeight, flip, hc, phi_cubic] <;> ring
+
+private theorem active_row_bound (j : Address) (w : Basis → ℂ) (z : Basis)
+    (ha : active j z = true) :
+    Complex.normSq (conjugateP j w z) ≤
+      phi^3 * rowWeight j z *
+        (Complex.normSq (w z) + Complex.normSq (w (flip (center j) z))) := by
+  have hd : realConjugate (diagonal j z) =
+      if z (center j) then phi^2 else -phi := by
+    unfold active at ha
+    simp only [Bool.and_eq_true, Bool.not_eq_true'] at ha
+    cases hz : z (center j) <;> simp [diagonal, ha.1, ha.2, realConjugate, hz]
+  have hc := cauchy_two (realConjugate (diagonal j z) : ℂ)
+    (conjugateBeta^3) (w z) (w (flip (center j) z))
+  simp only [conjugateP, ha, if_true]
+  refine le_trans hc ?_
+  apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ (add_nonneg (Complex.normSq_nonneg _) (Complex.normSq_nonneg _))
+  rw [hd]
+  simp only [map_pow, conjugateBeta_norm, Complex.normSq_ofReal]
+  have hp : phi^2 = phi+1 := Real.goldenRatio_sq
+  apply le_of_eq
+  cases hz : z (center j) <;> simp only [rowWeight, hz, Bool.false_eq_true,

+  ⟨operator_attach T C p q, archive_attach T C p q, calls_attach T C p q⟩
+
+private theorem label_attach (T : Tree L) (C : Path T → Tree M)
+    (p : Path T) (q : Path (C p)) :
+    label (graft T C) (attach T C p q) = label (C p) q := by
+  induction T with
+  | leaf l => rfl
+  | call j d U ih => exact ih C p q
+  | measure n select U ih =>
+    rcases p with ⟨o,p⟩
+    exact ih o (fun r => C ⟨o,r⟩) p q
+
+/-- A raw event on the full terminal record and the full terminal basis word. -/
+def eventMass (T : Tree L) (event : Path T → Basis → Bool) : ℝ :=
+  ∑ p, ∑ z, if event p z then mass T p z else 0
+
+/-! A history event is lifted to the complete terminal basis record without
+discarding any terminal word. -/
+def historyEvent {L : Type} {T : Tree L} (event : Path T → Bool) :
+    Path T → Basis → Bool := fun p _ => event p
+
+private theorem graft_event (T : Tree L) (C : Path T → Tree M)
+    (event : (p : Path T) → Path (C p) → Basis → Bool) :
+    eventMass (graft T C) (fun r z =>
+      event (split T C r).1 (split T C r).2 z) =
+      ∑ p, ∑ q, ∑ z, if event p q z then
+        Complex.normSq (((operator (C p) q * operator T p).mulVec omega0) z) else 0 := by
+  classical
+  unfold eventMass
+  rw [← (pathEquiv T C).symm.sum_comp]
+  rw [Fintype.sum_sigma]
+  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
+  intro p _
+  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
+  intro q _
+  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
+  intro z _
+  change (if event (split T C (attach T C p q)).1
+    (split T C (attach T C p q)).2 z then
+      mass (graft T C) (attach T C p q) z else 0) = _
+  rw [split_attach]
+  simp only [mass, (native_graft_semantics T C p q).1]
+
+private theorem graft_maxCalls (T : Tree L) (C : Path T → Tree M) :
+    maxCalls (graft T C) =
+      Finset.univ.sup (fun p => calls T p + maxCalls (C p)) := by
+  classical
+  apply le_antisymm
+  · apply Finset.sup_le
+    intro r _
+    have hr := attach_split T C r
+    have hs := Finset.le_sup (f := fun p => calls T p + maxCalls (C p))
+      (Finset.mem_univ (split T C r).1)
+    rw [← hr, calls_attach]
+    exact le_trans (Nat.add_le_add_left
+      (Finset.le_sup (Finset.mem_univ (split T C r).2)) _) hs
+  · apply Finset.sup_le
+    intro p _
+    have hn : (Finset.univ : Finset (Path (C p))).Nonempty := Finset.univ_nonempty
+    obtain ⟨q,_,hq⟩ := Finset.exists_mem_eq_sup Finset.univ hn (calls (C p))
+    rw [maxCalls, hq]
+    rw [← calls_attach T C p q]
+    exact Finset.le_sup (Finset.mem_univ _)
+
+end Tree
+open _root_.D5.S3.Quantum.Dynamics.NativeProtocolGraft.Tree
+
+inductive StopKind where
+  | failure | refusal | early | normal
+  deriving DecidableEq
+
+/-- The code retains distinct original terminal labels of the same kind.
+Only finitely many codes occur in each finite tree. -/
+structure Stop where
+  kind : StopKind
+  code : ℕ
+  deriving DecidableEq
+
+inductive Cut where
+  | active | absorbed (stop : Stop)
+  deriving DecidableEq
+
+/-- Original site b1 has shifted index 2. -/
+def readBit (i : Fin 16) (b : Basis) : Fin 2 := if b i then 1 else 0
+
+def extensionAt : Cut → (Fin 2 → Tree Stop) → Tree Stop
+  | .active, C => .measure 2 (readBit 2) C
+  | .absorbed s, _ => .leaf s
+
+def readTag : (cut : Cut) → (C : Fin 2 → Tree Stop) →
+    Path (extensionAt cut C) → Option (Fin 2)
+  | .active, _, q => some q.1
+  | .absorbed _, _, _ => none
+
+def extension (T : Tree Cut) (C : Path T → Fin 2 → Tree Stop)
+    (p : Path T) : Tree Stop := extensionAt (label T p) (C p)
+
+/-- The projection keeps the original program, full original path, original
+read and final stop. Only the added continuation path is forgotten. -/
+def projectRecord (T : Tree Cut) (C : Path T → Fin 2 → Tree Stop) (program : ℕ)
+    (r : Path (graft T (extension T C))) :
+    ℕ × Path T × Option (Fin 2) × Stop :=
+  let pq := split T (extension T C) r
+  (program,pq.1,readTag (label T pq.1) (C pq.1) pq.2,
+    label (extension T C pq.1) pq.2)
+
+/-- Per-original-record law, without conditioning, relabeling, or discarding
+zero, failed or stopped continuation positions. -/
+def projectedMass (T : Tree Cut) (C : Path T → Fin 2 → Tree Stop)
+    (program : ℕ) (event : (ℕ × Path T × Option (Fin 2) × Stop) → Basis → Bool) : ℝ :=
+  eventMass (graft T (extension T C)) (fun r z => event (projectRecord T C program r) z)
+
+/-- Complete suffix law at a cut. In the absorbed case it explicitly has no
+read label, no new archive and the identity operator. -/
+def CutLaw (cut : Cut) (C : Fin 2 → Tree Stop) : Prop :=
+  match cut with
+  | .active => ∀ (j : Fin 2) (q : Path (C j)),
+      readTag .active C ⟨j,q⟩ = some j ∧
+      operator (extensionAt .active C) ⟨j,q⟩ = operator (C j) q * projector (readBit 2) j ∧
+      calls (extensionAt .active C) ⟨j,q⟩ = calls (C j) q ∧
+      archive (extensionAt .active C) ⟨j,q⟩ = .report 2 j :: archive (C j) q ∧
+      label (extensionAt .active C) ⟨j,q⟩ = label (C j) q
+  | .absorbed s => ∀ q : Path (extensionAt (.absorbed s) C),
+      readTag (.absorbed s) C q = none ∧ operator (extensionAt (.absorbed s) C) q = 1 ∧
+      archive (extensionAt (.absorbed s) C) q = [] ∧
+      calls (extensionAt (.absorbed s) C) q = 0 ∧ label (extensionAt (.absorbed s) C) q = s
+
+/-- Every original native prefix has an exact all-menu, stop-aware graft with
+the same root, an exact original-record pushforward and the whole syntax cost.
+This is a semantic composition result, not a Petz implementation assertion. -/
+theorem original_native_projection (T : Tree Cut) (C : Path T → Fin 2 → Tree Stop)
+    (program : ℕ) (event : (ℕ × Path T × Option (Fin 2) × Stop) → Basis → Bool) :
+    projectedMass T C program event =
+      (∑ p, ∑ q : Path (extension T C p), ∑ z,
+        if event (program,p,readTag (label T p) (C p) q,label (extension T C p) q) z then
+          Complex.normSq (((operator (extension T C p) q * operator T p).mulVec omega0) z)
+        else 0) ∧
+    maxCalls (graft T (extension T C)) =
+      Finset.univ.sup (fun p => calls T p + maxCalls (extension T C p)) ∧
+    (∀ p, CutLaw (label T p) (C p)) ∧
+    (∀ (p : Path T) (q : Path (extension T C p)),
+      operator (graft T (extension T C)) (attach T (extension T C) p q) =
+        operator (extension T C p) q * operator T p ∧
+      archive (graft T (extension T C)) (attach T (extension T C) p q) =
+        archive T p ++ archive (extension T C p) q ∧
+      calls (graft T (extension T C)) (attach T (extension T C) p q) =
+        calls T p + calls (extension T C p) q ∧
+      label (graft T (extension T C)) (attach T (extension T C) p q) =
+        label (extension T C p) q) := by
+  refine ⟨?_, Tree.graft_maxCalls T (extension T C), ?_, ?_⟩
+  · exact Tree.graft_event T (extension T C) (fun p q z =>
+      event (program,p,readTag (label T p) (C p) q,label (extension T C p) q) z)
+  · intro p
+    cases label T p <;> simp [CutLaw, extensionAt, readTag, operator, calls, archive, label]
+  · intro p q
+    obtain ⟨ho,ha,hc⟩ := Tree.native_graft_semantics T (extension T C) p q
+    exact ⟨ho,ha,hc,Tree.label_attach T (extension T C) p q⟩
+
+
+#print axioms original_native_projection
+
+end D5.S3.Quantum.Dynamics.NativeProtocolGraft

+import LeanInformationAuditInterface.Contract.Registration
+import Reg.Support.SingleDependentReadout
+import D5.S3.Quantum.Dynamics.NativeProtocolBornNormalization
+
+/-! Whole-family readout of the original physical tree and position cut. -/
+
+noncomputable section
+open scoped BigOperators Matrix ComplexOrder MatrixOrder
+open LeanInformationAudit
+open _root_.D5.S3.ConceptDynamics.InformationEscape.DependentFamily
+open _root_.D5.S3.Quantum.Dynamics.NativeProtocolGraft
+open _root_.D5.S3.Quantum.Dynamics.NativeProtocolGraft.Tree
+open _root_.D5.S3.Quantum.Dynamics.NativeProtocolBornNormalization
+namespace Reg.D5.S3.Quantum.Dynamics.NativeProtocolBornNormalization
+local notation "NativeTree" => _root_.D5.S3.Quantum.Dynamics.NativeProtocolGraft.Tree
+
+structure Event (L : Type) where
+  tree : NativeTree L
+  event : Path tree → Bool
+  positions : Finset (Fin 16)
+
+abbrev signature : Signature where
+  Params := Type
+  State := Event
+  Role := Unit
+  finiteRole := inferInstance
+  nonemptyRole := inferInstance
+  Output _ _ := ℝ
+  Anchor := Empty
+  finiteAnchor := inferInstance
+
+def actual : Realization signature :=
+  realize signature (fun _ _ x => eventMass x.tree (historyEvent x.event)) (fun e => nomatch e)
+def rejected : Realization signature :=
+  realize signature (fun _ _ _ => 2) (fun e => nomatch e)
+
+abbrev arena : Arena where
+  signature := signature
+  Law r := ∀ (L : Type) (T : NativeTree L) (e : Path T → Bool) (I : Finset (Fin 16)),
+    (∑ p, ∑ z, mass T p z) = 1 ∧
+    (0 ≤ r.readout () L ⟨T,e,I⟩ ∧ r.readout () L ⟨T,e,I⟩ ≤ 1) ∧
+    (eventCut T I e).PosSemidef ∧
+    (eventCut T I e).trace = (r.readout () L ⟨T,e,I⟩ : ℂ)
+
+private theorem rejected_law : ¬ arena.Law rejected := by
+  intro h
+  have hp := (h Unit (.leaf ()) (fun _ => false) ∅).2.1.2
+  change (2 : ℝ) ≤ 1 at hp
+  norm_num at hp
+
+private theorem dependence : ObservationalDependence signature actual := by
+  intro i
+  cases i
+  refine ⟨Unit,⟨.leaf (),fun _ => false,∅⟩,⟨.leaf (),fun _ => true,∅⟩,?_⟩
+  change eventMass ((.leaf ()) : NativeTree Unit) (historyEvent (fun _ => false)) ≠
+    eventMass ((.leaf ()) : NativeTree Unit) (historyEvent (fun _ => true))
+  simp [eventMass, historyEvent, mass, operator, omega0]
+  apply ne_of_lt
+  exact_mod_cast (Finset.card_pos.mpr (Finset.univ_nonempty :
+    (Finset.univ : Finset (Path ((.leaf ()) : NativeTree Unit))).Nonempty))
+
+def family : Registration arena (type_of% (@original_complete_born_law)) where
+  actual := actual
+  bridge := Iff.rfl
+  variation := ⟨fun _ T e I => original_complete_born_law T e I,rejected,rejected_law⟩
+  sensitivity := by
+    constructor
+    · intro i
+      refine ⟨rejected,?_,?_,rejected_law⟩
+      · intro j h
+        exact (h (Subsingleton.elim _ _)).elim
+      · funext e
+        exact nomatch e
+    · intro e
+      exact nomatch e
+  dependence := dependence
+
+def registration : Contract.Registration.{_, _, _, 0, 0, 0, _, _, _, _, _, 0}
+    (@original_complete_born_law) (Realization signature) Unit Unit where
+  unitName :=
+    `D5.S3.Quantum.Dynamics.NativeProtocolBornNormalization.original_complete_born_law.__information_unit
+  realizationName :=
+    `Reg.D5.S3.Quantum.Dynamics.NativeProtocolBornNormalization.family
+  realizationSource := none
+  generated := false
+  arena := .source ⟨arena⟩
+  objectArena := .source ⟨arena⟩
+  catalog := Lean.Name.anonymous
+  localNames := false
+  realization := .source arena ⟨family⟩
+  correspondence := { stage := .evidence, objectStage := .evidence }
+  bundleNonempty := .absent
+  readout := some (realize signature
+    (fun _ _ x => eventMass x.tree (historyEvent x.event)) (fun e => nomatch e))
+  variation := .absent
+  sensitivity := .absent
+  partialSensitivity := none
+  escapeFrom := none
+  sourceSelection := none
+  continuation := .unknown
+  familyRecord := none
+  options := #[]
+
+#print axioms family
+#print axioms registration
+
+abbrev cutArena : Arena where
